description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the percentage point difference across various classifier configurations for morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models. The horizontal axis lacks a general title but displays four categorical configurations in the following order: "hidden:[50], linear", "hidden:[], linear", "hidden:[100], ReLU", and "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU". The vertical axis represents the "% point difference" on a linear scale, with values ranging from -0.2 to 0.2 and numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 0.1. The data is presented in grouped bars, where each category on the horizontal axis contains a pair of bars representing two models, as indicated by the top-right legend: "mBERT" in light blue and "XLM-R" in dark blue. Both sets of bars feature thin black outlines. For the "hidden:[50], linear" category, the mBERT bar extends downward to approximately -0.20 (the lowest value in the chart), while the XLM-R bar reaches about -0.06. In the "hidden:[], linear" category, both bars are positive, with mBERT at roughly 0.09 and XLM-R forming the tallest bar in the chart at approximately 0.21. The "hidden:[100], ReLU" category shows a negative value of about -0.11 for mBERT and a small positive value of roughly 0.02 for XLM-R. Finally, the "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU" category contains two negative bars, with mBERT at approximately -0.18 and XLM-R at -0.14. The categories are not sorted in a strictly ascending or descending order based on bar values, and horizontal grid lines are present across the chart background to aid in reading the values.
